title: HEXAPONG - A fast arcade game you can play in your browser.
author: HEXAPONG
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve been working on **Hexapong**, an evolution of Pong built around a changing multiplayer arena.

Each player defends one of the arena’s walls while trying to knock out their opponents. Matches feature modifiers that change how the game plays, so you have to adapt as well as react. Whenever a player is eliminated, their wall disappears and the arena changes shape making the remaining space smaller, stranger, and increasingly chaotic.

You can play immediately as a guest with no account required. Google and Apple sign-in are also available if you want to save your scores and compete on the leaderboards.

I’m continuing to improve the game and am also working toward releases on **iOS, Android, and Steam**.

If this sounds like your kind of game, I’d love for you to try it and tell me what you think:

[**hexapong.app**](http://hexapong.app)

I’m the developer, so I’m happy to answer questions or hear brutally honest feedback.
